steps.en: Install Raven, then pick a model provider and which built-in agents to enable
steps.zh: 装好 Raven，选模型供应商和要启用的内置 agent

steps.en: Copies the agent products into your raven home and puts them on the roster
steps.zh: 把各个 agent 产品拷进你的 raven 目录，登记进可调度名单

steps.en: Open the WebUI and describe the whole task once
steps.zh: 打开网页界面，把整件事一次说清

steps.en: Splits it into a dependency graph and assigns each node to a roster agent
steps.zh: 拆成带依赖的任务图，每个节点派给名单里的一个 agent

steps.en: Runs independent nodes in parallel and asks before risky actions
steps.zh: 互不依赖的节点并行跑，有风险的动作先问

steps.en: Approve, answer questions, or steer a running sub-agent
steps.zh: 批准、回答提问，或插话纠正正在跑的子 agent

steps.en: Merges node outputs into the deliverable and keeps context for next session
steps.zh: 汇总各节点产出交付，并把上下文记到下次会话

value.en: One brief to one surface, instead of juggling several agents and copy-pasting their outputs between them
value.zh: 一句需求交给一个入口，不用再在几个 agent 之间来回切换、手工搬运产出

sources: https://github.com/EverMind-AI/Raven/blob/main/README.md Quick Start (curl -fsSL https://raven.evermind.ai/install.sh | bash; the agents/ product tree is copied to your raven home on first use; setup asks per product which model it runs on)
https://github.com/EverMind-AI/Raven/blob/main/docs-site/docs/quick-start.md (raven onboard configures a model provider and chooses built-in agents; raven web opens the WebUI)

https://github.com/EverMind-AI/Raven/blob/main/docs-site/docs/orchestration.md (DAG: Raven validates the graph, dispatches nodes to roster agents, independent nodes run concurrently, dependent nodes receive earlier outputs)
https://github.com/EverMind-AI/Raven/blob/main/docs-site/docs/agent-collaboration.md (follow-up and steering of sub-agent instances, referenced from orchestration.md)
https://github.com/EverMind-AI/Raven/blob/main/README.md Core Systems (EverOS Memory preserves context across sessions)
